title: Singapore buses: weekday average daily boardings at Boon Lay Interchange, per month
brief: Revision 3 (Haoyang Shang, 2026-11-10): ready for production immediately; no unscored pilots. What will the average daily number of bus boardings (tap-ins) at Boon Lay Interchange (bus stop code 22009) be on weekdays that are not public holidays in the target month, as given by LTA DataMall's Passenger Volume by Bus Stops file for that month? First prospective scored target: December 2026; lock 2026-11-30 23:59 SGT, expected release 2027-01-10. AccountKey access was verified and August–October 2026 archived. Baseline and resolution rules remain unchanged.
question: What will the average daily number of bus boardings (tap-ins) at Boon Lay Interchange (bus stop code 22009) be on weekdays that are not public holidays in the target month, as given by LTA DataMall's Passenger Volume by Bus Stops file for that month?

source.publisher: Land Transport Authority (LTA), LTA DataMall, 'Passenger Volume by Bus Stops' (PV/Bus). Built from fare-card taps on buses (owner doc). Stop names from DataMall BusStops.
source.access: AccountKey access verified on 2026-11-10: train and bus archives for August, September and October 2026 are available. The key is read only from LTA_API_KEY; GitHub Actions requires the repository secret of that name. Rotate the previously exposed key. Capture both kinds continuously; only missing available months are requested. DataMall retains only three months. Original registration instructions and pre-key findings are preserved in revision 2 history.
source.archive_policy: Use: allowed. Automated retrieval: allowed in writing, with a key. Redistribution: allowed by the dataset licence, with one clause of unclear scope. Evidence: (a) DataMall's API terms, accepted at registration: 'Use of the datasets is governed by the Singapore Open Data Licence'; 'you can use, access, call, command, query or request the API, whether commercially or non-commercially'; 'You can call the APIs up to 10 million times a day'; cl. 10(b) keep credentials confidential and 'shall not mis-present or mask your API Client's identity'; cl. 10(e) data 'must only be released on or after the Effective Date (if any)' [verified, datamall.lta.gov.sg/content/datamall/en/api-terms-of-service.html fetched 2026-11-09T01:06Z]. (b) Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0 on DataMall: 'use, access, download, copy, distribute, transmit, modify and adapt the datasets' with attribution [verified, .../SingaporeOpenDataLicence.html]. (c) Unclear scope (lesson 10): DataMall's website Terms of Use say 'the Contents of this website shall not be reproduced, republished ... without the prior written permission of LTA' (cl. 5, 21) and 'The Contents of this website are strictly for your personal and non-commercial use only' (cl. 23), under the heading 'Restrictions on Use of Contents' / 'Copyright' [verified, .../term-of-use.html, last updated 25 Aug 2022]. Sorted by docs/sources.md §9: retrieval is covered by the API ToS; use and redistribution of datasets by the licence; cl. 5/21/23 read as covering the website's own pages ('Except as otherwise provided'), not datasets served under the licence, which is an inference [inferred]. Conditions: licence notice on the site; key kept secret; no suggestion of LTA endorsement. Proposed arena inventory row: rights 'approved', pending maintainers; one inventory row and one key cover the train and bus files. The optional publisher question is drafted in source.access; nobody sends it until a maintainer decides to.

target.population: Fare-card boardings (tap-ins) on public buses at the stop with code 22009 (Boon Lay Interchange, per the owner doc), on weekdays that are not public holidays. Cash fares, if any remain, are not in the file [unverified].
target.window: The target calendar month, rows with DAY_TYPE = 'WEEKDAY'.
target.calculation: From the month's PV/Bus file: sum TOTAL_TAP_IN_VOLUME over all TIME_PER_HOUR rows with PT_CODE = '22009' (text) and DAY_TYPE = 'WEEKDAY', after dropping rows with an empty TIME_PER_HOUR, divided by the number of Monday-to-Friday dates in the month that are not Singapore gazetted public holidays (Ministry of Manpower list, frozen in the round at posting). Rounded to the nearest whole tap. Owner input to check on first download: September 2026, 1.82 million tap-ins at Boon Lay Interchange over the month, with weekday peaks at 07:00 and 18:00.

lock: 23:59 Singapore time on the last day before the target month starts. No unscored pilot requirement (owner decision 2026-11-10). First prospective scored month: December 2026, lock 2026-11-30 23:59 SGT; expected release 2027-01-10. November is already underway and is not retrospectively admitted. The reference is October 2026, already archived. Publish the round on main before lock; missing reference means do not post.
baseline: Ranked zero point mean_k(k=1, lag=1, rms_n=12) (owner decision, rev 2; rev 1 called it 'pv_persistence'): mean = the stop's weekday average for the newest month in SSA's archive at lock, which is two months before the target. Spread, interim until 12 archived months exist: sd = mean x the RMS of LTA's system-wide public bus relative change over two months, 2023-2025 (6.66%; one-month lag 5.96%), a measured spread but measured on the network rather than the stop; afterwards sd = the RMS of the rule's own relative errors over the last 12 resolved months. Zero-point family (G1): one parameterised reference 'mean_k(k, lag, rms_n)': the mean of the k most recent eligible values in the lock capture, after skipping 'lag' newer ones not yet published, with sd = the root-mean-square of that same rule's errors over the rms_n most recent resolved targets in the lock capture (G2). Persistence is mean_k(k=1). Measured only at system level (LTA 'PT Ridership Monthly 2019-2025', average daily public bus ridership, all days, 36 months 2023-2025): persistence MAPE 4.67% (lag 1), 5.12% (lag 2); same month last year 4.18%; last year x last month's year-on-year ratio 3.63%, the best of the three for buses, unlike MRT, because bus ridership was flat (2025 over 2024 +0.1%) while MRT grew. Station-level weekday movement is unmeasured until the first download [unverified]. Before the first scored round a maintainer re-runs the spread check on the archive. After 12 months, the year-on-year reference becomes a shown baseline and a candidate zero point.
resolution: The first successful download, at or after 00:00 SGT on the 10th of the following month, of a file whose YEAR_MONTH is the target month. LTA's guide says (for all four PV APIs) the previous month's data 'is now generated on 10th of the month' (release note 6.1.1, 9 Oct 2024) and 'By 10th of every month' (§2.8); no time is given. Route A polls every 6 hours from the 10th; Route B is a named person's task on the 10th or 11th. The archived zip (bytes, sha256) is the record; LTA keeps no history, so a later download is not possible after three months. Revisions: none expected (doc); the first archived file wins.
missing_data_policy: (1) No file for the target month archived by 23:59 SGT on the 17th: the round is cancelled. (2) Stop 22009 missing from the file, or its WEEKDAY tap-ins zero in any hour 06-22: the round is cancelled and the card revised. (3) The reference month missing from the archive at lock: the round is not posted (a two-months-back file is not substituted under lock B). (4) If Boon Lay Interchange is relocated or renumbered (for example with the Jurong Region Line works), the round is cancelled unless LTA announced the new code before the lock. (5) Route B: if the named person has not filed the month by the 17th, (1) applies, and the watch notifies maintainers from the 11th (as for YouGov, lesson 4).
scoring: SSA topline scoring: mean and sd (sd > 0) or a quantile map including 0.5, CRPS; continuous_normal. Skill = 1 - CRPS(entrant) / CRPS(mean_k(k=1, lag=1, rms_n=12)). noise_floor is the wrong tool here (fare-card counts have no sampling noise, like Civiqs' smoothed series, docs/sources.md §1.4); the gate is the persistence error, which at system level is 4.7-5.1% a month for buses. One round a month, so a year gives 12 scored rounds per stop.

evidence.finding: [verified, guide v6.11 dated 30 Oct 2026] §2.5 PV/Bus and §2.6 PV/ODBus sit beside PV/Train (§2.8) with the same release rule. assumptions: Owner decision, 2026-11-10: remove the two unscored pilots and prepare production now. First prospective target December 2026, then monthly; all rounds scored. Existing lock, baseline, cancellation and resolution rules remain in force.
Full card instead of a blocked draft, per the owner's 2026-11-08 update. One DataMall key serves both PV cards and the mall carparks; the agent did not register.
Bus and train kept as separate cards with shared rules, so each can be approved or dropped on its own. Runner-up: one card with two round families.
Route A (automated with a key) proposed over Route B (manual), for the same reason as the train card; Route B is the fallback.

The by-stop file only; the OD file (about 240 MB a month per the doc) is not archived in this revision. Runner-up: archive it from the first month, since history is lost after three months; this is a storage decision for maintainers.
Suggested arena names: series 'sg_pv_bus_22009_weekday_tapin'; archive sources/lta-pv/bus/; round_id 'sg-pv-bus-bl-<YYYY-MM>'. Naming only.
